units.source_text: 先生没有说什么，好一会儿才说道：“我真的只是去扫墓。”

en.t: Sensei said nothing, and only after quite a while did he say, "I am really only going to visit a grave."

units.source_text: 先生似乎一定要把扫墓和散步截然分开似的。

en.t: Sensei seemed determined to draw a sharp line between visiting a grave and taking a walk.

units.source_text: 这会不会是不想带我去的借口呢？

en.t: Could this be an excuse because he did not want to take me with him?

units.source_text: 我觉得那时的先生简直像个孩子似的不可理喻，所以就更想去了。

en.t: I felt that Sensei at that moment was as unreasonable as a child, and that made me want to go all the more.

units.source_text: “好吧，扫墓也行，请带我一起去吧，我也去扫扫墓。”

en.t: "All right, even if it is a grave visit, please take me with you. I will visit the grave too."

units.source_text: 我觉得区分扫墓和散步是毫无意义的。

en.t: To me, distinguishing between visiting a grave and taking a walk seemed completely meaningless.

units.source_text: 这时，先生眉宇间忽然一暗，眼中也露出异样的光，

en.t: At that moment, Sensei's brow suddenly darkened, and a strange light appeared in his eyes,

units.source_text: 那仿佛是为难、厌恶、恐惧都无法表达的略带不安的神情。

en.t: a slightly uneasy expression that could not quite be called embarrassment, disgust, or fear.

units.source_text: 突然间，我清晰地回想起在杂司谷喊“先生”时的情景，

en.t: Suddenly, I vividly recalled the scene at Zoshigaya when I had called out "Sensei,"

units.source_text: 这两次的表情完全相同。

en.t: and the expression on his face was exactly the same both times.

units.source_text: 先生说：“由于不能对你说明的某种原因，

en.t: Sensei said, "For a certain reason that I cannot explain to you,

units.source_text: 我不想和别人一起去那儿扫墓，

en.t: I do not want to go there to visit the grave with anyone else,

units.source_text: 连妻子都没有跟我去过呢。”

en.t: not even my wife has ever gone with me."
